answers.explanation: Firmware is the software built into a device: BIOS or UEFI, router and switch OSes, embedded code.
Firmware runs underneath the OS, so the malware survives a reinstall. That's what makes it a prize target.
Dual (A/B) firmware is a redundancy measure.
Threat design or threat modeling is listed under firmware resourcefulness.
Obtain and verify: a fake update is a classic way to plant malicious firmware.
They find weaknesses before release, so the firmware holds up under attack.
Bricked. Dual firmware and tested restoration are how you avoid or fix it.
A copy the attacker can reach can be tampered with. Offline means a known-good version is always available.
Fast, automated updates shorten the window between a fix being released and every device having it.
